page.overview:
Who is Fiona Kelley?

Fiona Kelley belongs to James Bond. Beautiful, sophisticated, deadly.

No one but Fiona truly knows how many British agents and police have fallen for her. She is known to have 17 confirmed kills, including at least one member of the CIA, MI6, CSIS and the Mossad. Unconnected to any of the known Irish independence movements, investigations of her benefactors has repeatedly resulted in the sudden and surprising deaths of the investigating agent.
